source.title: Laundry room rules
source.description: Shows the laundry room's rules and opening hours to everyone who passes the screen. Nothing about any person, and nothing on a screen visible from outside the building.
rules.heading: Laundry room
rules.book: Book your time on the board in the laundry room or on the association's website.
rules.clean: Clean the machines, the drum and the floor after use.
rules.lint: Empty the lint filter of the tumble dryer.
rules.late: A time not taken within 30 minutes of its start is free for anyone.
hours.heading: Opening hours
